name: US Tornadoes: has tornado country moved?
blurb: Every US tornado since 1950, from NOAA's Severe Weather Database. Watch the Great Plains' share of (E)F1-and-stronger tornadoes fall from 41% in the 1950s to 21% in the 2020s while the Southeast's rises from 19% to 37%, then dig into any state, season, hour or rating.
